description: Route customer support messages to one of four queues. The candidate replaces a strict routing prompt with a friendlier, more thorough prompt.

baseline.name: triage-baseline-strict-label
baseline.system_prompt: You route customer support messages. Classify the message into exactly one category: billing, technical, account, or shipping. Reply with the category name only, in lowercase, with no punctuation or explanation.

candidate.name: triage-candidate-helpful-prompt
candidate.system_prompt: You are a friendly and thorough customer support assistant. For every customer message: first restate the customer's problem in your own words, then explain step by step which support category fits best and why, then suggest a helpful first reply the support agent could send, and finally state the category. The categories are billing, technical, account, and shipping. Be empathetic and complete.

cases.prompt: I was charged twice for my subscription this month. Can you refund the duplicate payment?
The app crashes every time I try to upload a photo larger than 5 MB.
How do I change the email address on my profile? I no longer use the old one.
My package was marked as delivered yesterday, but nothing arrived at my door.
Your invoice adds VAT even though I entered our company's tax ID at checkout.
Since this morning's update the dashboard only shows a blank white page in Firefox.
Please permanently delete my account and all of the data you hold about me.
My order hasn't shipped yet. Can I switch it to express delivery?

reference_pricing.source: Notional per-token rates entered for the demo. Replace them with your provider's prices; local inference has no per-token bill.
